info.title: SunReye Core API
info.description: Monitoring core: accounts, onboarding and capabilities.

post.summary: Only while no account exists: the first one is the admin, every later one is created by an admin.
A connection on its own, before any device is on it.

Whether something accepts a connection at the endpoint: no unit id, no register read. A failure is a
result (`ok: false`), not an error of the request.
The first unit id that answers a one-register read with the profile's map. Only reads.

delete.summary: Refused while any device, retired included, is on it.

patch.summary: Every device on the connection follows it.

get.summary: Every device, retired ones included, with every connection.

delete.summary:
Only a device that never stored a reading: one with history is refused with `field: "history"`, so
the page offers retiring it instead.

get.summary: The uncurtailed PV potential; null while the forecast is off or unconfigured, or no irradiance was had.
What the feed-in cap and the battery leave of it; null as for the raw forecast.
The last readings of every metric, bucketed, to seed the live sparklines.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: How far back the window reaches. Default 300.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: `plant`, or a device's decimal id. Without it, the first device in service.

get.summary: Minute, hour or day buckets of one metric, UTC, oldest first; the newest hour and day are open.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: `plant`, or a device's decimal id. Without it, the first device in service.

parameters.name: inverterId
parameters.description: As `source`, which wins when both are set.

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: How far back from now. Default 168. Ignored when `from` and `to` are both set.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the window, RFC 3339, inclusive.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the window, RFC 3339, exclusive.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Most buckets, oldest first. Default 5000; without a session at most 12000.

422.description: A per-device metric read for a plant of several members

get.summary: Public, so the login page can offer the kiosk view.
The active profile as the dashboard builds itself from it.

put.summary: Saving polls the device as soon as a profile is chosen too.

post.summary: A device that cannot be reached is a result (`ok: false`), not an error of the request.

Fetches the source and replaces what an earlier fetch of it stored, polling devices by the new
definitions. An invalid profile is skipped and reported; the rest load.

delete.summary:
Removes a stored source and the profiles only it supplied. The source that supplies the active
profile stays.

parameters.name: baseUrl
parameters.description: The base URL as the source was added.

parameters.name: indexPath
parameters.description: The index path as the source was added.

post.summary:
Validates the uploaded profile file and stores it, replacing an earlier import of its id; devices are
polled by the new definition. The rejection names the field, never the value.

requestBody.description: The profile JSON file, as text

delete.summary:
Removes an imported profile, or one a source supplied. A compiled-in profile and the active one stay;
devices poll only the active one, so polling is untouched.

get.summary: The saved zone, or the host's while none is saved.

put.summary: A patch of the plant-level fields; arrays, panel physics and the battery are edited on the inverter.

get.summary: The plant and every device a series may be read from.

Account.description: The signed-in account as the SPA reads it.

restartRequired.description: Always false: the device is polled with the new profile at once.

skipped.description: Files the index listed that did not load, with why.

ApiKeyView.description: A key as listed: never the key itself.

Battery.description: The battery the forecast's clipping sim models.

Capabilities.description: The SPA areas this core serves; the SPA hides every area that reads false.

integrations.description: Coded integrations and the MQTT connections they run over.

pvAndBattery.description: An inverter's PV arrays and battery pack, kept per device.

Catalog.description: The active profile and the entities it reads.

ConnectionChoice.description: An existing connection by id, or one to create with the device.

kind.description: Accepted when it is the connection's own kind.

enabled.description: Apply the learned correction; it learns either way.

factor.description: The multiplier applied, shrunk and clamped.

maeCorrected.description: The same with the correction applied, W.

maeRaw.description: Decayed mean absolute error without the correction, W.

enabled.description: Applied to the forecast; it learns either way.

learnedThrough.description: The last plant-local day learned, `YYYY-MM-DD`; null before the first run.

CreatedApiKey.description: The only answer that holds the key.

DetailedPoint.description: One slot of the Solcast-shaped curve Home Assistant PV blueprints read.

oneOf.description: `null` removes the pack; absent leaves it.

retired.description: True retires the device: kept with its history, no longer polled. False restores it.

systemLoss.description: `null` falls back to the plant's; absent leaves it.

tempCoefficient.description: `null` falls back to the plant's; absent leaves it.

DeviceState.description: Why a device is, or is not, polled.

slug.description: The device id as a decimal string.

EndpointProbe.description: Whether something accepted a connection at an endpoint, as 3.x answers it.

logger.description: Over Solarman V5: the serial the stick named itself with.

ErrorBody.description: What a failed request answers: `{"error": "..."}` with the status that names the fault.

field.description: The request field the refusal concerns, when the client acts on it.

Feature.description: An optional subsystem the roles of a profile show.

Flow.description: What the sign of a signed metric means.

detailedForecast.description: The Solcast-shaped curve Home Assistant PV blueprints read.

fetchedAt.description: When the irradiance was fetched, UTC ISO 8601.

stale.description: The last fetch failed: this is built from the irradiance before it.

ForecastExport.description: One view as 3.x exports it, with the age of its irradiance.

ForecastView.description: One power projection over the series and its sums.

remainingTodayKwh.description: From `now` to plant-local midnight, the running slot prorated.

FoundUnit.description: The unit id that answered, and how long its read took.

controls.description: Keys of the metrics the profile marks writable.

phases.description: 1 or 3, from distinct grid phase voltage indices.

InverterConfig.description: The inverter connection as the onboarding form edits it.

host.description: Null until a connection is saved.

loggerSerial.description: The stick's serial, for `solarman-v5`; without one it is learned from the stick on connect.

simulate.description: Always false: the core has no fake device.

timeoutMs.description: Bounds the connect and every read of one poll.

Listed.description: A stored source with the ids of the profiles it supplied.

Logger.description: The stick that answered an endpoint probe.

rememberMe.description: Keep the session for a year instead of until the browser closes.

MetricKind.description: How a widget treats the metric.

ModbusParams.description:
A Modbus endpoint. `timeoutMs` and `pollIntervalMs` are the core's, for every connection, and
`/api/settings/inverter` sets them: an edit stating other values is refused, an add ignores them.

NewConnectionRequest.description: A connection as a writer states it.

kind.description: `modbus`; the core reaches no other kind.

via.description: `profile` or absent; the core authors no other tier.

NewUserRequest.description: An account an admin creates; the admin hands the password to its person.

members.description: The `plant` source's history members by slug; empty when nothing can be summed.

ProbeRequest.description: An endpoint to test, as the connection dialog holds it.

kind.description: `modbus`; the core reaches no other kind.

installed.description: Downloaded from a profile source. The compiled-in profiles are not.

PvArray.description: One PV array: panels sharing an orientation.

mppt.description: `index` of the inverter's `pv.string.*` metrics this array is wired into.

systemLoss.description: %; the inverter's, else the plant's, when absent.

tempCoefficient.description: %/°C; the inverter's, else the plant's, when absent.

Recent.description: Every point is at `t0 + o[i] * step * 1000` milliseconds, so no timestamp repeats.

candidates.description: The ids to ask, in order, at most 16; by default 1, 0, 2, 3, 4, 5.

kind.description: `modbus`; the core reaches no other kind.

profileId.description: Whose register map the scan reads with.

Series.description: One metric's points: `o[i]` steps after `t0`, holding `v[i]`.

needsSetup.description: No account exists yet: the first sign-up creates the admin.

Skipped.description: A file the index listed that did not load.

SnapshotMetric.description: One decoded value of a test read.

arrays.description: Every in-service inverter's, in roster order.

oneOf.description: The in-service inverters' packs as one.

houseLoadW.description: W; inferred from history when null.

smartMeterSince.description: `YYYY-MM-DD` the smart meter gateway was installed.

Source.description:
Where a source's profile files live. No credentials: a URL with userinfo, a query or a fragment is
refused, so nothing secret is stored or logged.

baseUrl.description: `https://` base the index and every profile path resolve against.

indexPath.description: Path of the index under the base, e.g. `index.json`.

member.description: Whether the plant series is read from this device.

devices.description: Every device in roster order, retired ones included.

Storage.description: Where a metric's values are kept.

TestRequest.description: A connection to test, with the profile to read it with. Without one the active profile is used.

TestResult.description: The outcome of a test read: an error, or the captured snapshot.

Transport.description: How the connection is framed on the wire.

scanned.description: Every id asked, in order, so a miss names what was ruled out.

WeatherPatch.description: A `PUT /api/settings/weather` body: absent keeps the stored value, `null` clears a nullable one.
